name: fj
description: Forgejo in a pane: the oldest issue assigned to you and the epics of a milestone, for the repo behind the current directory's origin

label.title: Epic label
label.description: The label that marks an issue as an epic.

childrenHeading.title: Children heading
childrenHeading.description: The ## heading in an epic's body under which its child issues are listed as a checklist.

login.title: Login
login.description: Your Forgejo login, for Assign to me. Empty asks Forgejo, which needs FORGEJO_TOKEN to have the read:user scope.

token.title: Token
token.description: A Forgejo access token, kept in secure storage. Empty uses FORGEJO_TOKEN from the environment. Needs read:issue; write:issue for Assign to me.
